headline: Areas across Bangladesh to face 8-hour power outage from morning
summary: Several regions across Bangladesh are scheduled to experience an 8-hour electricity cut starting from morning. Details on the specific affected areas are currently unavailable.

headline: Little Riya, shot, dies; two coordinators rescued with eyes blindfolded
summary: A young girl named Riya, who sustained a gunshot wound, has tragically passed away. Concurrently, two individuals described as coordinators were found rescued, blindfolded, in connection with the incident.
details: A young girl named Riya, who sustained a gunshot wound, has tragically passed away. The circumstances surrounding her death are currently under investigation by authorities.
In a related development, two individuals identified as coordinators were found and rescued. They were reportedly discovered with their eyes blindfolded, suggesting a possible abduction or detention.
Further details regarding the shooting incident, the identities of the rescued coordinators, and the location of these events are yet to be fully disclosed.
caption:
